problem_statement: A test that selects the test_utils_main_exit_cb module and provides a function test_utils_main_exit_cb(int res) should be able to have the integer result of the program's main reported to that callback after main returns, so it can print SUCCESS or FAILED based on that result. Today selecting this module does not build. This lets a test that does not provide its own main still report success or failure from the entry-point's result.
